semanticCriteria.acceptable: A sendable draft preserving the intended person, all stated factual and action statuses, dates, conditions, uncertainty, numerical units, and exact literals.
semanticCriteria.critical: A missing or changed addressee, alternative, negation, amount, unit, condition, time direction or exact literal; invented action or copied writer instruction.
semanticCriteria.minor: Harmless sentence shape or tone differences.
semanticCriteria.gate: All 16 first-run cases must be review-ready with zero critical meaning errors and zero literal violations.
